title: Renewal Offer Rent on a Home-Site Lease: Computation Bulletin
content:
**Accounting bulletin — the rent written on a Home-Site Lease renewal offer**

The rent offered on the renewal of a fixed-term Home-Site Lease is defined as follows, each amount read from the lease on the day the offer is issued.

1. **Twelve-month-equivalent rent.** The current monthly site rent on the lease, plus the lot class's twenty-four-month reduction when the current term is a twenty-four-month term. For a current twelve-month term it is simply the current monthly site rent.
2. **Renewal increase rate.** The lot class's twelve-month renewal increase rate, as a percentage.
3. **Dollar increase.** The twelve-month-equivalent rent multiplied by the renewal increase rate and divided by one hundred, rounded half up to the cent.
4. **Raised rent.** The twelve-month-equivalent rent plus the dollar increase.
5. **Twelve-month offer.** The raised rent.
6. **Twenty-four-month offer.** Worked out the same way with the lot class's twenty-four-month renewal increase rate taking the place of the twelve-month rate, and then reduced by the lot class's twenty-four-month reduction.
7. **Month-to-month offer.** The twelve-month offer plus the lot class's month-to-month premium.

The rounding falls on the dollar increase; the raised rent is the sum of two amounts already in cents.

### Worked example (hypothetical lot class figures)

Hypothetical inputs: a current twenty-four-month term at 690.00; a twenty-four-month reduction of 16.00; a twelve-month renewal increase rate of 5.0 percent; a twenty-four-month renewal increase rate of 4.2 percent; a month-to-month premium of 45.00.

| Line | In words | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Twelve-month-equivalent rent | 690.00 plus the 16.00 reduction, the current term being twenty-four months | 706.00 |
| Dollar increase, twelve months | 706.00 multiplied by 5.0, divided by one hundred | 35.30 |
| Twelve-month offer | 706.00 plus 35.30 | 741.30 |
| Dollar increase at 4.2 percent | 706.00 multiplied by 4.2, divided by one hundred (29.652), rounded half up | 29.65 |
| Twenty-four-month offer | 706.00 plus 29.65, less the 16.00 reduction | 719.65 |
| Month-to-month offer | 741.30 plus 45.00 | 786.30 |

### Rounding illustration (hypothetical)

A current twelve-month rent of 653.00 at a rate of 4.6 percent gives 30.038, rounded half up to 30.04, and a twelve-month offer of 683.04.
